title: Elegance Cottage Seaside, FL
meta_description: Elegance is in the center of town, meaning you are close to it all things Seaside. The first floor includes a queen bedroom with a private bath, separated from the main house by a covered porch.
description_expanded: Description161 SMOLIAN CIRCLE2 KINGS, 1 QUEEN, 2 TWINS, 2 BUNK BEDSA Corner-Lot Retreat in the Heart of Seaside, FloridaNestled on picturesque Smolian Circle in Seaside, FL, Elegance is a truly one-of-a-kind beach cottage offering the perfect balance of walkable access to town and peaceful, private outdoor living. As one of the larger homes in Seaside, this exceptional retreat sits on a spacious corner lot, framed by a classic white picket fence and lush landscaping that creates a sense of privacy while keeping you steps from everything Seaside has to offer. Designed with large families and groups in mind, Elegance features multiple outdoor gathering spaces and generous interiors ideal for relaxation, entertaining, and making lasting memories.Inviting Outdoor Living Spaces on Every LevelFrom the moment you arrive, Elegance makes a statement with its charming exterior, highlighted by a bright pink front door and two spacious screened-in porches flanking the entry. Each porch is thoughtfully furnished with Adirondack chairs, benches, ceiling fans, and ambient lighting—perfect for morning coffee or winding down in the evening. Across the back of the home, a large screened porch overlooks the expansive backyard and offers additional Adirondack seating and a bench swing for laid-back afternoons.Upstairs, guests can enjoy a grand open-air second-floor porch complete with Adirondack seating and a sun deck, while the fourth-floor open-air tower deck delivers sweeping views and unforgettable sunsets over Seaside. With outdoor spaces on nearly every level, Elegance invites you to enjoy coastal living from sunrise to sunset.Spacious Living, Dining, and Kitchen for GatheringInside, the home opens to a welcoming foyer that flows into a spacious living room designed for connection and comfort. A large sectional sofa, club chairs, chaise lounger, and built-in bay window seating create a warm gathering space centered around a flat-screen TV—perfect for family movie nights or quiet evenings in.The open-concept kitchen is well suited for extended stays and group meals, featuring a central island with seating for four, a large double-door refrigerator, abundant cabinetry, and a walk-in pantry. Just off the kitchen, the formal dining room showcases an expandable table that comfortably seats 8–10 guests, making it ideal for shared meals, celebrations, and holiday gatherings. A conveniently located half bath completes the main living level.Five Bedrooms Designed for Comfort and PrivacyElegance offers five thoughtfully designed bedrooms, providing space and privacy for guests of all ages. On the ground floor, a private queen suite—separate from the main living area—features a flat-screen TV, custom wrap-around bench seating with storage, and an ensuite bath with a single vanity and glass-enclosed shower.The second floor is home to four additional bedrooms. A king bedroom with a private furnished balcony and flat-screen TV shares a spacious hall bath with dual vanities, a glass-enclosed walk-in shower, and a deep soaking tub. A nearby twin bedroom is perfect for younger guests. The primary king suite offers a private ensuite bath with dual vanities, a glass-enclosed walk-in shower, generous closet space, and a flat-screen TV. Completing this level is a custom bunk room that sleeps four and includes its own private bathroom—ideal for kids or teens.Tower Room and Panoramic Views Above the TreetopsThe third floor reveals an enclosed tower room, serving as a flexible bonus space with a lounge area and a card table for four—perfect for games, reading, or quiet downtime. From here, a spiral staircase leads to the fourth-floor open-air tower deck, where Adirondack seating and 360-degree panoramic views showcase Seaside, the Gulf, and breathtaking sunsets that truly set this home apart.An Unforgettable Seaside EscapeWith its prime Smolian Circle location, expansive living spaces, and unmatched outdoor areas, Elegance offers an exceptional Seaside vacation experience for families and friends alike. Whether you’re enjoying peaceful mornings on the screened porch, gathering around the dining table, or taking in sunset views from the tower, this stunning home provides the perfect setting for an unforgettable coastal getaway in Seaside, Florida.(For additional room, the one-bedroom guest house, Enchantment, may also be rented)* 5-night minimum Spring, Spring Break, Summer; 3 night Fall; 2-night minimum Winter. Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign registration.FEATURES2,903 square feet352 yards or a 4-minute walk to beach accessPrivate Seaside residential beach access at West Ruskin Pavilion, the largest private beach on 30AFour expansive porches and a tower with Gulf viewsAccess to 3 swimming pools, 5 Clay tennis courts, and 3 Pickleball courts (court fees apply), plus a fitness centerWelcome tote with 2 beach towels, a bottle of wine, and 2 complimentary rental bikes for pickup at Seaside Transit AuthorityPersonalized service throughout your stay with starter amenities provided2 parking passes are issued for two-bedroom and larger homes A golf cart is considered a car. Golf carts for non-homeowners visiting Seaside are prohibited. Special circumstances and medical needs requests require a golf cart permit.No pets allowedSTR23-001937
